does: Tells whether a target (an entity or a position) is within a spell's ranges from a source, given the source's bounds, the spell flags and the spell kind; returns the entity found in range or the null handle.

evidence.says: takes BoundComponent, two Vector3f, the spell's Ranges, eoc::ESpellFlags and ESpells; reads eoc::BoundComponent, eoc::sight::DataComponent, esv::Character and esv::Item of the target

A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a fight was on (the segments where an enemy took its turn), about 8 100 times from 2 places, bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x3616EA0 and bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x41C2D20
EoCServer.dll exports this name; the symbol database finds the export again in the executable at this function by the likeness of the two pseudo-codes
the macOS build's symbols hold this name; it is tied to this function by the job its read shows
